faqs.question: How long does standard delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days.

faqs.question: Do you provide shipment tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tracking information is provided after the order has been shipped.

faqs.question: What payment options are available?
faqs.answer: Customers can use the payment methods supported during checkout.

faqs.question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Order modifications are possible only before the order enters processing.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders may be cancelled before they are shipped.

faqs.question: Do products have a warranty?
faqs.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the product and its applicable warranty terms.

faqs.question: How can I update my account information?
faqs.answer: Account information can be updated through the account settings available in the customer account.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: Customers can contact the support team through the available customer support channels.
